# gpdf JSON — Document Definition Spec (canonical)

> Everything you need to write the JSON that gpdf's `template.FromJSON` accepts, in one file: prose, the JSON Schema, and verified examples. To have an AI write gpdf JSON, hand it this file as is.

- Published at: `https://gpdf.dev/spec/gpdf-json-spec.en.md` (Japanese: `gpdf-json-spec.ja.md`)
- JSON Schema: `https://gpdf.dev/schema/gpdf.schema.json` (same as Appendix A)
- Generated file. The sources live under `schema/` in the gpdf repository

🔴 **Every JSON document in this file has been run through the implementation.** Tests check the Appendix A schema against the Go types gpdf decodes into, and every Appendix B example passes the schema and renders to a PDF.

---

## 1. Write, check, fix

A document is **one JSON file**. Four steps:

1. **Write.** Start from the closest example in Appendix B.
2. **Validate against the schema.** Run any JSON Schema validator against Appendix A (or the URL above). Unknown fields, invalid colors, invalid dimensions and out-of-range `span` values fail here.
3. **Render.** Turn it into a PDF with the program in "7. Rendering".
4. **Inspect.** Follow "8. Checking the output" to make sure no text is garbled and no element went missing.

- 🔴 **gpdf itself silently swallows many mistakes.** Elements with invalid values are dropped and a PDF is still produced without an error ("6. What gets silently swallowed"). So **never skip steps 2 and 4.** A successful render does not mean the document came out as intended.
- **Appendix A is the source of truth for field names, types, enums and formats.** This prose does not repeat them.

## 2. Document structure

The top level is `page` (required) plus the fields that hold content.

| Field | Role |
|---|---|
| `page` | Paper size, orientation, margins, and a background shared by every page |
| `metadata` | Title, author, etc. embedded in the PDF |
| `header` / `footer` | Rows repeated at the top / bottom of every page |
| `body` | Body rows. **Breaks to a new page automatically** when it does not fit |
| `pages` | An array of explicitly separated pages, each with its own `body` |
| `absolute` | Elements placed at given coordinates (stamps, watermarks, margin notes) |

- You can use both `body` and `pages`. `body` comes first as page 1, then `pages` follow.
- **Use `pages` only when you want to decide the page breaks yourself.** Long tables and text placed in `body` flow onto the next page on their own.

### Rows and columns (12-column grid)

The body is **a sequence of rows (`row`)**, and each row lays out **columns (`cols`)** left to right. A column's width is its `span`; **the spans in a row must add up to 12.**

- 🔴 **Nothing checks that the spans add up to 12** (the schema only checks that each `span` is 1–12). Above 12, the row runs off the right edge; below 12, the right side stays empty.
- To leave a gap, add a column with no content (`{"span": 4, "text": ""}`).
- Row height grows with its content by default. Writing a dimension in `height` fixes it.

### Column content: shorthand and `elements`

To put a single element in a column, write it directly on the column (**shorthand**).

```json
{ "span": 12, "text": "Heading", "style": { "size": 18, "bold": true } }
```

To stack several, list them in the `elements` array, each with a `type`.

```json
{ "span": 12, "elements": [
  { "type": "text", "content": "Heading", "style": { "size": 18, "bold": true } },
  { "type": "spacer", "height": "4mm" },
  { "type": "text", "content": "Body" }
]}
```

- 🔴 **When `elements` is present, every shorthand field on the same column (`text`, `table`, …) is ignored.** Do not mix them.
- The shorthand `text` string becomes `content` inside `elements`.

## 3. Elements

There are 13 `type` values. See Appendix A for each element's fields.

| `type` | What it places | Shorthand |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | Text. `style` sets size, bold, color, alignment, background, padding, etc. | `text` + `style` |
| `link` | Linked text. The URL goes in `style.link` (blue and underlined by default) | none |
| `richText` | One paragraph with per-fragment styling (a bold phrase, an inline link) | `richText` |
| `image` | PNG / JPEG / SVG. `src` is a data URI, file path, base64, or SVG markup | `image` |
| `table` | Header row plus data rows. Long tables continue across pages | `table` |
| `list` | Bulleted list (`"ordered"` for numbered) | `list` |
| `line` | Horizontal rule | `line` |
| `spacer` | Vertical space (`height` is a dimension) | `spacer` (dimension string) |
| `qrcode` | QR code | `qrcode` |
| `barcode` | Barcode (Code 128) | `barcode` |
| `box` | Container with background, border, rounded corners and padding. Stacks `elements` inside; can be nested | `box` |
| `pageNumber` | Current page number (use in `header` / `footer`) | none |
| `totalPages` | Total page count | none |

- **`header` / `footer` use the same rows and columns as the body.** For page numbers, put `pageNumber` in the `elements` of a `footer` column.
- `pageNumber` and `totalPages` output only the number. For "1 / 3", place them in adjacent columns.

## 4. Dimensions and colors

- **Dimensions are strings with a unit:** `mm` / `cm` / `in` / `pt` / `em` / `%`. A bare number means `pt`. The exact format is `dimension` in Appendix A.
- **Only font size (`size`) and letter spacing (`letterSpacing`) are numbers, in pt.**
- **Colors are strings:** `#RRGGBB` / `rgb(r, g, b)` (each 0.0–1.0) / `gray(v)` (0.0–1.0) / eight names. Note that `rgb()` is **not 0–255**.
- **An `opacity` of 0 means "unset = opaque", not "transparent".** For a faint watermark, use a value above 0 such as 0.1–0.3.
- Per-edge fields (`paddings` / `margins` / `widths`) use CSS order: **top, right, bottom, left**.

## 5. Fonts

- **Without a registered font, the PDF standard fonts (Helvetica family) are used.** In practice they cover **ASCII only**.
- 🔴 **Japanese, Chinese and Korean text becomes `?` unless a font is registered.** It is not an error. Non-ASCII symbols such as `—` (em dash) also disappear or turn into other characters with the standard fonts.
- **Registering fonts is the renderer's job (Go), not the JSON's.** `fontFamily` in JSON can only pick a registered name; an unregistered name **silently falls back to the default font**.
- 🔴 **Table cells have no `fontFamily` field and are drawn with the default font.** So for documents with CJK text, **register the font as the default font** ("7. Rendering"). Then the JSON needs no `fontFamily` at all.
- `bold` / `italic` render in the regular face unless a font file for that face is registered.

## 6. What gets silently swallowed

gpdf **does not raise an error** for the following; it drops them or falls back to defaults and still produces a PDF. Some fail at step 2 (schema); others only show up at step 4 (inspection).

| What you wrote | What gpdf does | Where you can catch it |
|---|---|---|
| An unknown field (typo, nonexistent feature) | Ignored | Schema |
| An invalid element color (`"#ggg"`, `"rgb(255,0,0)"`, …) | That color setting is ignored | Schema |
| An invalid dimension in `row.height` | **The whole row disappears** | Schema |
| An invalid dimension in `spacer` | The space disappears | Schema |
| An unknown `type` | The element disappears | Schema |
| Both `elements` and shorthand fields | The shorthand disappears | Visual check |
| An unreadable image (wrong path, broken base64) | **The image disappears** | Visual check |
| Spans not adding up to 12 | Overflows or leaves a gap | Visual check |
| An unregistered `fontFamily` | Falls back to the default font | Visual check |
| Non-ASCII text with the standard fonts | Becomes `?` or disappears | `pdftotext` |
| `bold` / `size` / `fontFamily` in a table's `headerStyle` | **Ignored** (only `color` and `background` apply) | Visual check |
| `type: "link"` without `style.link` | Rendered as plain text | Visual check |

**What does raise an error:** JSON syntax errors, an unknown paper size, an invalid dimension in `page.margins`, and an invalid color or image in the page background (`page.background`).

## 7. Rendering

Pass the JSON to `template.FromJSON` and call `Generate`. The program below works as is. Passing a font file as the third argument registers it as the default font.

```go
// render: go run . <in.json> <out.pdf> [font.ttf]
package main

import (
	"log"
	"os"

	"github.com/gpdf-dev/gpdf/template"
)

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) < 3 {
		log.Fatal("usage: render <in.json> <out.pdf> [font.ttf]")
	}
	src, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	var opts []template.Option
	if len(os.Args) > 3 { // CJK etc.: register the font and make it the default
		font, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[3])
		if err != nil {
			log.Fatal(err)
		}
		opts = append(opts,
			template.WithFont("Main", font),
			template.WithDefaultFont("Main", 10))
	}
	doc, err := template.FromJSON(src, nil, opts...)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	pdf, err := doc.Generate()
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Args[2], pdf, 0o644); err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
}
```

```sh
go mod init render && go get github.com/gpdf-dev/gpdf
go run . invoice.json invoice.pdf                       # ASCII-only document
go run . quote.json quote.pdf NotoSansJP-Regular.ttf    # document with Japanese text
```

- **Image file paths are relative to where the program runs.** When in doubt, embed the image in the JSON as a data URI.
- If you pass data as the second argument of `FromJSON`, the JSON is first expanded as a **Go template** (`{{.Name}}`, etc.). When rendering JSON an AI wrote, pass `nil`.

## 8. Checking the output

**A successful render does not mean the result is what you intended** ("6. What gets silently swallowed"). Once you have a PDF, check:

1. **Is the text there?** Extract it with `pdftotext out.pdf -` and make sure **there are no runs of `?`** and every sentence you wrote is present. A missing font registration shows up here.
2. **Is the page count as expected?** `Pages` in `pdfinfo out.pdf`. Two pages where you expected one means something overflowed onto a new page.
3. **How does it look?** Read the PDF directly if you can; otherwise turn it into images with `pdftoppm -png -r 60 out.pdf page`. Missing images, overflowing columns and header styles that did not apply only show up here.

When an AI writes the JSON, **the AI can run these three checks itself and fix what it finds.** With rendering and checking in the AI's hands, a person only needs to look once, at the end.

## Appendix A. JSON Schema

This is the only source of truth for field names, types, enums and patterns. The prose above does not repeat them.

#### `gpdf.schema.json`

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://gpdf.dev/schema/gpdf.schema.json",
  "title": "gpdf Document Schema",
  "description": "JSON schema for gpdf PDF generation library. Defines the declarative document format accepted by template.FromJSON().",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["page"],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "page": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/page",
      "description": "Page-level settings (size, margins)."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/metadata",
      "description": "Optional document metadata (title, author, etc.)."
    },
    "header": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Rows rendered at the top of every page.",
      "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/row" }
    },
    "footer": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Rows rendered at the bottom of every page.",
      "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/row" }
    },
    "body": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Main content rows. Automatically paginated.",
      "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/row" }
    },
    "pages": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Explicit page definitions. Each entry becomes one page with its own body and absolute elements.",
      "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/pageBody" }
    },
    "absolute": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Absolute-positioned elements on the first page (or all pages when used with body).",
      "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/absolute" }
    }
  },
  "$defs": {
    "dimension": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "A dimension value with unit. Supported units: mm, cm, in, pt, em, %. A bare number defaults to pt. 'auto' is also accepted.",
      "pattern": "^(auto|[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?(mm|cm|in|pt|em|%)|[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?)$"
    },
    "color": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "A color value. Supported formats: named colors (red, blue, ...), hex (#RRGGBB), rgb(r, g, b) with 0.0-1.0 floats, or gray(v) with 0.0-1.0.",
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "enum": ["black", "white", "red", "green", "blue", "yellow", "cyan", "magenta"]
        },
        {
          "pattern": "^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$"
        },
        {
          "pattern": "^rgb\\(\\s*[0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+\\s*,\\s*[0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+\\s*,\\s*[0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+\\s*\\)$"
        },
        {
          "pattern": "^gray\\(\\s*[0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+\\s*\\)$"
        }
      ]
    },
    "page": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Page-level settings.",
      "required": ["size"],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "size": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Page size (ISO 216 A/B series, ISO 269 C series and DL, or US Letter/Legal). Case-insensitive.",
          "enum": ["A0", "A1", "A2", "A3", "A4", "A5", "A6", "A7", "A8", "A9", "A10", "B0", "B1", "B2", "B3", "B4", "B5", "B6", "B7", "B8", "B9", "B10", "C0", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "C5", "C6", "C7", "C8", "C9", "C10", "DL", "Letter", "Legal"]
        },
        "orientation": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Page orientation. \"landscape\" swaps width and height of the page size.",
          "enum": ["portrait", "landscape"]
        },
        "margins": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension",
          "description": "Uniform page margins (e.g. \"20mm\", \"15pt\")."
        },
        "background": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/background",
          "description": "Background drawn beneath the content of every page."
        }
      }
    },
    "background": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Full-page background: an optional solid color with an optional image on top. Ignores page margins.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "color": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/color",
          "description": "Solid fill color for the whole page."
        },
        "image": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Background image source: data URI, file path, or raw base64 string."
        },
        "fit": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "How the image is scaled to the page (centered). Default \"cover\".",
          "enum": ["cover", "contain", "stretch", "original"]
        },
        "opacity": {
          "type": "number",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 1,
          "description": "Opacity of the background (0.0 transparent – 1.0 opaque). 0 or omitted means fully opaque."
        }
      }
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Document metadata embedded in the PDF.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "title": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Document title."
        },
        "author": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Document author."
        },
        "subject": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Document subject."
        },
        "creator": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Creator application name."
        }
      }
    },
    "row": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "A row wrapper containing a row definition.",
      "required": ["row"],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "row": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/rowDef"
        }
      }
    },
    "rowDef": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Row definition with height and columns.",
      "required": ["cols"],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "height": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Row height. Use \"auto\" for automatic height or a dimension (e.g. \"12mm\")."
        },
        "cols": {
          "type": "array",
          "description": "Columns in this row. Uses a 12-column grid system.",
          "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/col" }
        }
      }
    },
    "col": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "A grid column. Specify content via shorthand fields (text, image, etc.) or the elements array for multiple elements.",
      "required": ["span"],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "span": {
          "type": "integer",
          "description": "Column span in the 12-column grid (1-12).",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 12
        },
        "text": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Shorthand: text content for this column."
        },
        "image": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/image",
          "description": "Shorthand: image element."
        },
        "table": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/table",
          "description": "Shorthand: table element."
        },
        "list": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/list",
          "description": "Shorthand: list element."
        },
        "line": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/line",
          "description": "Shorthand: horizontal line element."
        },
        "spacer": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension",
          "description": "Shorthand: vertical spacer with the given height."
        },
        "qrcode": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/qrcode",
          "description": "Shorthand: QR code element."
        },
        "barcode": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/barcode",
          "description": "Shorthand: barcode element."
        },
        "richText": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/richText",
          "description": "Shorthand: rich text paragraph with mixed inline styles."
        },
        "box": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/box",
          "description": "Shorthand: styled container with nested elements."
        },
        "style": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/style",
          "description": "Text style applied to the text shorthand field."
        },
        "elements": {
          "type": "array",
          "description": "Multiple elements in this column. Use instead of shorthand fields when a column needs more than one element.",
          "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/element" }
        }
      }
    },
    "element": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "A content element within a column or absolute container.",
      "required": ["type"],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Element type.",
          "enum": ["text", "link", "richText", "image", "table", "list", "line", "spacer", "qrcode", "barcode", "box", "pageNumber", "totalPages"]
        },
        "content": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Text content (for type \"text\" or \"link\"; a link takes its URI from style.link)."
        },
        "style": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/style",
          "description": "Text styling properties."
        },
        "image": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/image",
          "description": "Image configuration (for type \"image\")."
        },
        "table": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/table",
          "description": "Table configuration (for type \"table\")."
        },
        "list": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/list",
          "description": "List configuration (for type \"list\")."
        },
        "line": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/line",
          "description": "Line configuration (for type \"line\")."
        },
        "height": {

        },

        },
        "border": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/border",
          "description": "Border around the image."
        },
        "background": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/color",
          "description": "Color drawn behind the image (visible around a \"contain\" fit or through transparency)."
        },
        "borderRadius": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension",
          "description": "Clips the image to rounded corners of this radius."
        },
        "opacity": {
          "type": "number",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 1,
          "description": "Opacity of the image (0.0 transparent – 1.0 opaque). 0 or omitted means fully opaque."
        },
        "link": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "URI the image links to (e.g. \"https://gpdf.dev\")."
        }
      }
    },
    "table": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Table element with header and data rows.",
      "required": ["header", "rows"],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "header": {
          "type": "array",
          "description": "Header row cell texts.",
          "items": { "type": "string" }
        },
        "rows": {
          "type": "array",
          "description": "Data rows. Each row is an array of cell text strings.",
          "items": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": { "type": "string" }
          }
        },
        "columnWidths": {
          "type": "array",
          "description": "Relative column widths as percentages (e.g. [35, 35, 30]).",
          "items": { "type": "number" }
        },
        "headerStyle": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/style",
          "description": "Styling for the header row."
        },
        "stripeColor": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/color",
          "description": "Alternating row background color."
        },
        "cellVAlign": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Vertical alignment of cell content.",
          "enum": ["top", "middle", "bottom"]
        },
        "columnAlign": {
          "type": "array",
          "description": "Per-column horizontal alignment, in column order.",
          "items": { "type": "string", "enum": ["left", "center", "right"] }
        },
        "border": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/border",
          "description": "Outer frame around the whole table."
        },
        "cellBorder": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/border",
          "description": "Border drawn around every header and body cell (a uniform grid)."
        },
        "borderCollapse": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "Merge adjacent cell borders into a single line (like CSS border-collapse: collapse). Default false (separated)."
        },
        "background": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/color",
          "description": "Fill color of the table's outer box."
        }
      }
    },
    "list": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "List element (ordered or unordered).",
      "required": ["items"],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "List type. Defaults to \"unordered\" (bullets).",
          "enum": ["ordered", "unordered"]
        },
        "items": {
          "type": "array",
          "description": "List item texts.",
          "items": { "type": "string" }
        }
      }
    },
    "line": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Horizontal line (rule) element.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "color": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/color",
          "description": "Line color."
        },
        "thickness": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension",
          "description": "Line thickness (e.g. \"1pt\", \"0.5mm\")."
        }
      }
    },
    "qrcode": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "QR code element.",
      "required": ["data"],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "data": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Data to encode in the QR code."
        },
        "size": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension",
          "description": "QR code size (width and height)."
        },
        "minSize": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension",
          "description": "Minimum display size. If the layout would shrink the QR code below this value it overflows to the next page instead."
        },
        "errorCorrection": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Error correction level. L=~7%, M=~15% (default), Q=~25%, H=~30%.",
          "enum": ["L", "M", "Q", "H"]
        }
      }
    },
    "barcode": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Barcode element.",
      "required": ["data"],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "data": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Data to encode in the barcode."
        },
        "width": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension",
          "description": "Barcode width."
        },
        "height": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension",
          "description": "Barcode height."
        },
        "format": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Barcode format.",
          "enum": ["code128"]
        }
      }
    },
    "border": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Border specification.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "width": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension",
          "description": "Uniform border width."
        },
        "widths": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension" },
          "minItems": 4,
          "maxItems": 4,
          "description": "Per-edge widths in CSS order [top, right, bottom, left]."
        },
        "color": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/color",
          "description": "Border color."
        },
        "style": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["solid", "dashed", "dotted", "none"],
          "description": "Border line style."
        }
      }
    },
    "box": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Styled container that stacks its elements vertically. Boxes can be nested.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "width": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension",
          "description": "Explicit box width."
        },
        "height": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension",
          "description": "Explicit box height."
        },
        "padding": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension",
          "description": "Uniform inner padding."
        },
        "paddings": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension" },
          "minItems": 1,
          "maxItems": 4,
          "description": "Per-edge padding in CSS order [top, right, bottom, left]. Overrides padding."
        },
        "margin": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension",
          "description": "Uniform outer margin."
        },
        "margins": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension" },
          "minItems": 1,
          "maxItems": 4,
          "description": "Per-edge margin in CSS order [top, right, bottom, left]. Overrides margin."
        },
        "background": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/color",
          "description": "Background fill color."
        },
        "border": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/border",
          "description": "Border around the box."
        },
        "elements": {
          "type": "array",
          "description": "Elements placed inside the box.",
          "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/element" }
        },
        "borderRadius": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension",
          "description": "Rounds the corners of the box background and uniform border."
        },
        "opacity": {
          "type": "number",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 1,
          "description": "Opacity of the box and its content (0.0 transparent – 1.0 opaque). 0 or omitted means fully opaque."
        },
        "link": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "URI the box and its content links to (e.g. \"https://gpdf.dev\")."
        }
      }
    },
    "absolute": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Absolute-positioned container placed at fixed XY coordinates on the page.",
      "required": ["x", "y", "elements"],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "x": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension",
          "description": "X coordinate from the left edge."
        },
        "y": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension",
          "description": "Y coordinate from the top edge."
        },
        "width": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension",
          "description": "Width constraint for the container."
        },
        "height": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/dimension",
          "description": "Height constraint for the container."
        },
        "origin": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Coordinate origin. \"content\" = relative to content area (inside margins). \"page\" = relative to page corner.",
          "enum": ["content", "page"],
          "default": "content"
        },
        "elements": {
          "type": "array",
          "description": "Elements to render at this position.",
          "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/element" }
        }
      }
    },
    "pageBody": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Content definition for a single explicit page.",
      "required": ["body"],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "body": {
          "type": "array",
          "description": "Rows for this page.",
          "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/row" }
        },
        "absolute": {
          "type": "array",
          "description": "Absolute-positioned elements for this page.",
          "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/absolute" }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Appendix B. Examples

Every example below passes Appendix A and renders through `template.FromJSON` in gpdf's test suite. Start from the closest one.

#### `01_hello.json`

```json
{
  "page": { "size": "A4", "margins": "20mm" },
  "body": [
    { "row": { "cols": [
      { "span": 12, "text": "Hello, World!", "style": { "size": 24, "bold": true } }
    ]}}
  ]
}
```
